payload.requestedOutcome: Implement HTTP-SES as the Factory Sessions service-owned HTTP adapter. Decode/map Sessions HTTP requests through the accepted Sessions root, translate typed errors, and prove fake-root parity for mapping and cancel/timeout behavior without importing Sessions internals or owning canonical state. Do not author shared OpenAPI or perform PSS-I02 route/client fan-in. Do not edit pkg/wire, pkg/root, pkg/initializer, top-level CLI composition, or reopen Sessions IMP/LWR/CLI ownership. Shared coverage, ownership, and package-target manifest edits are allowed and must be rebased through the merge loop. Explicitly loop through implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete the Factory work.

payload.requestedOutcome: After HTTP-SES completes, reconcile queue/session/PR/CI evidence, repair any stranded merged tasks, compare IMP-PROV-04 only if IMP-PROV-03 is terminal, keep IMP-WORK-03 gated on accepted IMP-WORK-02, keep further VIS work gated on live VIS/CTR evidence, prefer HTTP-PSES/MCP-SES and other lease-disjoint Phase-3 adapters from the live ready set, and refill maximum safe throughput toward executor-slot capacity 16.
